annotations.title: List the bookings in your connected calendars

description:
List the bookings in your connected calendars

Returns the bookings of every active integration that has a calendar (Cal.com, Calendly, Google Calendar, Outlook), sorted by start, or of one integration when you pass `integrationId`. Each booking carries the `id` that the confirm, decline and cancel paths take. Bookings are read live from the calendar provider on every request, so poll at a calm pace (once a minute is plenty) rather than in a tight loop. Each calendar is read across every page its provider hands out, up to a fixed limit, and over a fixed window: Cal.com and Calendly from 3 months back, Google Calendar and Outlook from now, each up to 12 months ahead. `from` and `to` only narrow that window, so a range outside it comes back empty without the calendar being listed in `failed`. A calendar that could not be read in full this time is listed in `failed`. When it could not be read at all, none of its bookings are in `data`. When it was read only in part (a later page failed, or it holds more bookings than the limit), the bookings that were read are in `data` and the rest are missing.

from.description: Only bookings that start at or after this moment. ISO 8601 with time and offset. It narrows the window each calendar is read over and does not widen it.

status.description: Only bookings in these states, as a comma separated list of `accepted`, `pending`, `cancelled` and `rejected`. Case does not matter.

to.description: Only bookings that start at or before this moment. ISO 8601 with time and offset. Must not be earlier than `from`.

name: list_bookings
title: List the bookings in your connected calendars
